name: Cruel Hewdown
description: A downward chop opens the chain and leaves the head moving into the next cut.

name: Brutal Warpoll
description: The axe turns over at the bottom of a cut and rises into a second cleave on the opposite line.

name: Rooted Warbeard
description: A single raised haft catches a counter-blow between two cuts without breaking the chain.

name: Coasting Haftcap
description: A paired step keeps the user at striking distance from a retreating opponent throughout the chain.

name: Smiteswat
description: Qi passes from one stroke to the next, so each link in the chain lands heavier than the last.

name: Stalling Rive
description: The user ends the chain by hooking the opponent's blade with the beard and pulling it off line.

name: Smitescreen
description: The beard snares a spear shaft or blade and pulls it past the user's side.

name: Viselike Brunt
description: The haft pins a trapped weapon against the opponent's body and holds it there with leaning weight.

name: Entangling Warcleave
description: With the beard hooked on a weapon, a sharp wrist turn pries it from the opponent's hand.

name: Warbitprop
description: The hooked beard holds an enemy blade away from the body while the haft guards the user's side.

name: Bruntprop
description: Qi stiffens the beard so a hooked limb or weapon cannot be shaken off for a moment.

name: Bruntflog
description: The haft lock is let go and the bit chops through the opening it leaves.

name: Crescentbit Zip
description: The user steps through the opponent's guard on the line of a hooked weapon.

name: Honedwarbit
description: The head turns in the hands so the blunt poll strikes where the bit was aimed.

name: Crimson Banded
description: The head rolls over the lead hand so the beard side cuts in from below.

name: Wideeye Buckle
description: A quarter spin of the head across the body turns a thrust aside and sets up a cut.

name: Battleheel Swerve
description: A rotating step carries the user behind a spun head and out of line of the counter.

name: Honed Smite
description: The head makes a full turn around the hands before descending with the speed of the spin.

name: Poise Bitedge
description: Qi gathers in the spinning head so each turn leaves it heavier and faster.

name: Staticbrunt
description: A spinning head raps an arm or blade in passing and spoils the opponent's timing.

name: Static Battercut
description: The head swings across to the weaker hand's side and cuts from an unexpected angle.

name: Wild Warhelve
description: A feinting diagonal cut draws the opponent's guard to one side.

name: Raw Banded
description: A crossing cut follows on the opposite line and strikes the guard that moved.

name: Armored Warbit
description: The haft sweeps up between the two cuts and covers the user's head from a counter.

name: Lithe Warbit
description: Two quick steps close on the opponent as the first cut lands.

name: Acrid Warcleave
description: Qi lets the second cut follow so fast it seems to land with the first.

name: Bruntbuckle
description: The first cut strikes the blade and the second slips past the rattled guard.

name: Rushing Battleheel
description: The cutting edge strikes in a clean arc for the straight cut that the axe is made for.

name: Smiteflog
description: The lower beard cuts upward under a raised guard and bites the arm.

name: Rivebuckle
description: The flat of the head shoves a shield or weapon aside, opening the line for the bit.

name: Haze Wideeye
description: The edge catches a blade and rebounds it, turning a cut away from the body.

name: Crescentbit Hasp
description: The beard hooks an ankle in a low sweep and pulls the opponent's footing out.

name: Brass Warhelve
description: The bit cuts high and the beard follows from low, striking two heights in a single turn.

name: Bandedlinen
description: Qi runs along the whole edge, adding bite to every cutting stroke for the next few exchanges.

name: Bruntglide
description: A step to the side follows a rim shove, bringing the bit onto the exposed flank.

name: Sturdy Haftcap
description: Bit, beard and rim cover the high, middle and low lines in one held guard.

name: Cruel Bitedge
description: The head turns through each edge in order, striking from three different angles in one sweep.

name: Raw Hewdown
description: A chop lands on one spot of a shield's face, splitting the wood along the grain.

name: Ruthless Rive
description: Qi in the edge helps the bit bite deep into plank cover and tear it open.

name: Warpoll Carapace
description: A hard blow to the shield's boss shakes the bearer's arm and weakens his hold.

name: Rooted Bitedge
description: The user's haft guards the face from flying splinters after a shield splits.

name: Lurching Battercut
description: The bit follows a seam between boards and pries the shield apart.

name: Warbitstalk
description: A quick step carries the user inside the broken shield before it can be raised again.

name: Smitescorer
description: The axe rebounds out of the split wood and returns at once to cut the bearer.

name: Brawnwarbit
description: The axe whirls in a wide circle around the user and the bit strikes the nearest opponent.

name: Clayrive
description: The head orbits the body at shoulder height, cutting whoever steps inside the circle.

name: Stubborn Battleheel
description: The haft turns in front of the body in a steady wheel that turns aside thrusts and thrown blows.

name: Warbeard Curl
description: A spinning slide carries the user away from a grapple on the line of the whirl.

name: Rubblebanded
description: A low sweeping orbit cuts at the legs of every nearby foe at once.

name: Poisewarbit
description: A wheeling parry catches a blade and throws it off the circle.

name: Soothing Warbeard
description: Qi gathers in the whirling head, and each lap adds weight to the next cut.

name: Hewdown Buckle
description: The wheel is cut short by a pull that hooks an enemy weapon out of line.

name: Brawn Wideeye
description: At the end of the whirl the whole weight of the head comes down on one target.

name: Hum Brunt
description: The wheel reverses direction and catches an opponent who stepped in on the expected line.

name: Patient Haftcap
description: A long in-breath sends qi to the shoulders and eases the lift of a heavy head.

name: Brunt Hammerfall
description: The breath is let out as the heavy head falls, and the cut lands with its whole weight.

name: Buttressed Banded
description: The haft rests on the shoulder and held breath steadies the user while the head covers the line.

name: Slinking Warhelve
description: A short step in a low breath keeps the user steady beneath the heavy axe.

name: Hungry Warcleave
description: A held breath turns the cut into a sudden hooking stroke from a shouldered guard.

name: Warpoll Prop
description: The heavy head catches a cut and its weight turns the blow aside.

name: Lassoing Smite
description: The flat of the head shoves the front of a rank and unsteadies the line.

name: Bandedthwack
description: A chop strikes the gap that a shove opens between two guards.

name: Brass Battercut
description: The bit falls on the join of an armour plate, forcing the edge into the seam.

name: Stalling Wideeye
description: The beard hooks the shield of one foe and drags him into the path of the next.

name: Brawn Smite
description: The user steps forward under the haft's cover and holds the line against a push.

name: Brass Rive
description: The head is brought down onto an opponent's raised guard with qi behind it.

name: Sprig Crescentbit
description: The haft is set across the body and held firm so the user holds a position against a press.

name: Rugged Warbeard
description: A low sweeping stroke cuts across the line, striking several opponents at once.

name: Honedbanded
description: The haft catches a blow and the bit falls in a counter-chop before the opponent resets.

name: Ember Warhelve
description: The user steps inside a swing and chops the exposed forearm.

name: Brassbattle
description: After a counter the haft returns across the body at once, covering a second attack.

name: Prowling Warbit
description: A sliding step avoids a thrust and brings the user around to the opponent's open side.

name: Draught Crescentbit
description: A pulse of qi in the haft throws a blow back along its line and opens the opponent's guard.

name: Hum Hewdown
description: The counter-cut strikes the opponent's weapon hand, breaking the rhythm of his attack.

name: Emberbanded
description: Two short chops follow a counter and keep the opponent from regaining his stance.
